_comment: How a saved user name fills the {username} placeholder of a folder. Read by the frontend (src/components/CloudSetupWizard.test.ts: resolveUsernameTemplate, profileOverlayScope, the setup wizard's profileRoot and aeroCloudBase) and by the backend (cloud_provider_factory.rs profile_root, crypt_overlay_provider.rs profile_overlay_scope), so both insert the same folder name. The user name goes in exactly as saved, in one literal pass; a null path means a blank user name, which leaves the template as written.
